# Paul Irving & Twin Sailors

- [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — presumed Friend of — [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md) — imaginary rock people who come ashore to talk with him · since v2  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) writes a letter describing his imaginary friends at the shore, including [Nora](../character/nora.md), the [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md), and the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md) of the cave. He details magical adventures, such as sailing into a moonglade and visiting the sunset land. He concludes the letter with a postscript clarifying that the stories are not real.
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

> [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) confides her worries about Miss Lavendar's melancholy behavior to [Anne](../character/anne.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne.md) to promise to return for a extended visit to cheer her up. After a outdoors tea with strawberries, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) sits with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) in the garden and shares stories about her imaginary dream-boy, which resonates deeply with Paul's own imagination before [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

> During a cold winter, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) spend time together, though [Anne](../character/anne.md) senses a lingering distance and occasional resentment from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). Captain Jim explains to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that Leslie's past tragedy creates a barrier between them. After [Anne](../character/anne.md) hints at her pregnancy, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) reacts coldly but later gifts her a handmade baby dress. Meanwhile, Captain Jim shares his journal of sea adventures with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), who hope someone will one day write his life story.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER
